summary: Preserved candidate PR 1557's valid Anthropic tool-reference conversion and deferred-tool routing, while correcting the two concrete PR 1642 classifier counterexamples: unrelated telemetry.type comparisons no longer imply native support, and fully bracketed function/defer_loading access is recognized.
